articles.summary: Together with researchers from the SDG Impact Lab at the University of Oxford, we set out to better understand the thrill of driving and explore whether it can be measured. The anatomy of performance follows that work across four episodes.
articles.title: The anatomy of performance: can Oxford find a way to measure the thrill of driving?

articles.summary: Maria Uggla, Head of C&M Design at Polestar, shares how design can be a force for progress and why our partnership with Dutch Design Week is a key step forward.
articles.title: Polestar x Dutch Design Week: Rethinking materials with Maria Uggla

articles.summary: Polestar (Nasdaq: PSNY) reports retail sales of estimated 14,371 cars in the third quarter and estimated 44,790 cars in the first nine months of 2026, both up around 1% year-on-year.
articles.title: Polestar reports record nine-month retail sales and its strongest third quarter
